# agent-handoff-kit

> AI coding agent context generated by agent-handoff-kit.

## Summary

agent-handoff-kit is a node.js project.

## Useful Entry Points

- `AGENT_HANDOFF.md`: repository snapshot for coding agents.
- `AGENTS.md`: operating rules for AI coding agents.
- `handoff-pack.md`: copy-paste context bundle for a new chat.
- `AGENTS.md`: project documentation.
- `README.md`: project documentation.

## Commands

- `npm test` - node --test
- `npm run smoke` - node ./bin/agent-handoff-kit.js --dry-run
